description: [provider] Count lookalike companies for a seed (free). Returns the total count of similar companies matching the given search criteria without retrieving the actual results (CompanyEnrich · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE, and the single most valuable call on this provider given similar-company rows cost 5 credits each. Tune `minScore` and the filters against the count until the audience is the size you want, then buy exactly that many rows.

minScore.description: 0-1 similarity floor — raise it here for free until the count looks right

name: companyenrich_companies_similar_count
